objective.description: Propose a read-only consumer that can join the Mycelix development map into Symthaea EGDDM without promoting source-declared claims or transferring authority.
objective.required_capability: two-sided, versioned schema/contract conformance for cross-project map consumption
acceptance_evidence: exact owner-published contract identifier, version and schema blob digest
two-sided owner acknowledgement or equivalent source-backed contract identity
independent conformance fixtures for supported map producers and the read-only consumer
explicit unknown/stale/contested handling with authority non-transfer

critical_unknowns: whether each owner explicitly accepts this exact schema blob as its producer contract
whether the consuming implementation handles each producer's actual required/optional fields and semantic invariants
whether provenance and lifecycle semantics are preserved rather than coerced
whether source-declared maturity can be misrepresented as compiler/runtime/independent evidence

hard_constraints.rule: No production consumer implementation may be proposed as immediately feasible until exact two-sided contract conformance is established.
No map or federation edge may grant authority or promote a source-declared claim.
No repository code/build/test execution is authorized in this synthetic task.
All planned work must fit the resource budget or be explicitly conditional/deferred.

evidence_state.scope: four exact artifact commit trees were fetched and each member map path/blob pair matched
evidence_state.limitation: does not prove schema semantics or runtime interoperability

evidence_state.scope: all four local maps declare schema_version 0.1.0
evidence_state.limitation: same version string does not prove same schema blob or semantic conformance

evidence_state.scope: no independently reviewed owner-to-owner contract conformance receipt in this fixture
no executable read-only consumer conformance result

actions.description: Reconfirm exact map blob, source revision/tree, shared schema blob and artifact commit pins for Symthaea and Mycelix.
actions.acceptance: all four identity dimensions resolve exactly; mismatches remain explicit

actions.description: Request and record explicit two-sided owner review of the exact schema blob, required fields, semantic invariants, provenance authority levels and source-declared maturity limitations.
actions.acceptance: both owners reference the same exact contract ID/version/blob; disagreement or no response remains unknown

actions.description: Author producer/consumer fixture pairs and negative controls for source-declared authority, missing fields, stale maps and claim-promotion attacks.
actions.acceptance: fixtures cover all agreed contract semantics; test execution remains separately gated

actions.description: Immediately implement a cross-project consumer using only schema_version 0.1.0 equality.
actions.acceptance: not eligible while prerequisites are missing

actions.description: Run a broad source inventory over both repositories without first resolving the exact owner contract.
actions.acceptance: does not satisfy the two-sided contract prerequisite

actions.description: Run an unrelated Symtropy physics performance benchmark.
actions.acceptance: does not reduce uncertainty about the map contract

actions.description: Do not implement until the required owner contract evidence can be obtained.
actions.acceptance: retains unknown contract status and identifies the missing owner evidence

candidate_plans.claimed_benefit: resolve critical contract uncertainty before implementation
candidate_plans.plan_rationale: spend budget on exact evidence and owner agreement first; only then open a separately gated implementation proposal

use when owner evidence cannot be obtained within the decision horizon
